title: Lester Young as a pleasant surprise
summary: Herschel Evans used to phone the Reno Club so Clayton could hear the band, and told him about Lester, Jones, Page and Lips.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Yes, yes. Well was, apart from the rhythm section, was Lester Young the big surprise to you?

You see, when we were in California, Herschel used to call up the band. He used to call up Reno long distance and tell whoever answered the 'phone, whoever he'd be talking to and it might have been a girl, but anyway, he could hear the band playing, and he'd say, Buck, come here, come here. And I'd listen. I'd listen on the 'phone, to these guys and I'd say, damn, boy those guys are sure swinging, which they were. And then Herschel, had worked with them

before and he'd tell me all about, he'd worked with them when Basie was playing with Benny Moten at different times. And he told me all about Lester. He told me all about Jo Jones. All about Page. Lips, Basie.
